_doc: World clock (WorldClock.gd, GAME_ROADMAP.md section 5). Time is a day counter that moves on actions: expeditions (travel + floors) and resting at the Inn. Each day the world ticks: bounty deadlines, injuries and Lost & Found count down; the shop restocks weekly; a world event can start each week. What happened goes to the news ledger shown in town.

time_costs._doc: An expedition costs the location's travel_days (Locations tab) + expedition_base_days + days_per_extra_floor x (floors entered - 1), rounded down; +defeat_extra_days if you were carried back.

inn._doc: One night costs copper_per_level x level. Resting passes days (injuries heal, the board refreshes, the shop restocks).

shop._doc: Consumable prices drift up to +/- price_drift per item each week.

events._doc: At the start of each week one event may begin (chance), lasting duration_days. Effects: enemy_power and reward_mult apply in the event's location (a random one if location is 'random_themed'); consumable_price, upgrade_fee and inn_price apply everywhere.

monster_surge.name: Monster Surge
monster_surge.news: Scouts report a monster surge in {location}! The creatures are stronger, but so are the spoils.
monster_surge.end_news: The monster surge in {location} has died down.

harvest_festival.name: Harvest Festival
harvest_festival.news: The Harvest Festival fills the square. Merchants and the inn are offering festival prices.
harvest_festival.end_news: The festival stalls are packed away.

smiths_fair.name: Smiths' Fair
smiths_fair.news: The Smiths' Fair has come to town. The Blacksmith's upgrade fees are lower this week.
smiths_fair.end_news: The Smiths' Fair has moved on.

caravan.name: Merchant Caravan
caravan.news: A merchant caravan rolls in: the shop has fresh stock today.
